FxFloatOn.label: Float
FxFloatOn.hint: The letters (or words, lines, the whole text) drift and sway gently, all through the clip.

FxFloatLetters.label: Letters
FxFloatLetters.hint: Which letters it is on: all of them, only the letters selected in the viewer when you chose this (Use Selected Letters picks again), or all but those.

FxFloatLettersUse.label: Use Selected Letters
FxFloatLettersUse.hint: Takes the letters selected in the viewer now.

FxFloatPieces.label: Float By
FxFloatPieces.hint: What floats as one piece: each letter, each word, each line, or the whole text.

FxFloatStyle.label: Float Style
FxFloatStyle.hint: Random: each piece keeps its own time. Wave: a wave runs through the text. Together: all in step.

FxFloatAmount.label: Float Amount
FxFloatAmount.hint: How far they drift: multiplies Float X, Y and Size (0: they only turn).

FxFloatRotation.label: Float Rotation
FxFloatRotation.hint: How much they turn: multiplies Float Angle (0: they only drift).

FxFloatSpeed.label: Float Speed
FxFloatSpeed.hint: How fast they float (1: a swing about every 3 seconds).

FxFloatX.label: Float X
FxFloatX.hint: Sideways, in % of a letter's height.

FxFloatY.label: Float Y
FxFloatY.hint: Up and down, in % of a letter's height.

FxFloatSize.label: Float Size
FxFloatSize.hint: Growing and shrinking a little, in % of its size.

FxFloatAngle.label: Float Angle
FxFloatAngle.hint: Rocking side to side, in degrees.

FxFloatWave.label: Wave Length
FxFloatWave.hint: Wave styles: how many pieces one wave spans.

FxFloatPace.label: Pace Variation
FxFloatPace.hint: Random style: how differently the pieces keep time (0: all at one pace).

FxFloatRipple.label: Ripple
FxFloatRipple.hint: A quicker little wave on top of the swing (0: one smooth swing).

FxFloatEaseIn.label: Ease In (seconds)
FxFloatEaseIn.hint: The float grows from still over this time from the clip's start (0: floating from the first frame).

FxFloatSeed.label: Float Seed
FxFloatSeed.hint: Another random pattern for the same settings.

FxGlowOn.label: Glow
FxGlowOn.hint: A soft glow round the whole text, in its own colours or one colour.

FxGlowLetters.label: Letters
FxGlowLetters.hint: Which letters it is on: all of them, only the letters selected in the viewer when you chose this (Use Selected Letters picks again), or all but those.

FxGlowLettersUse.label: Use Selected Letters
FxGlowLettersUse.hint: Takes the letters selected in the viewer now.

FxGlowTextColors.label: Text's Colors
FxGlowTextColors.hint: On: the glow takes the letters' own colours. Off: Glow Color.

FxFireOn.label: Fire
FxFireOn.hint: Flames, embers and heat round the letters (light added over the picture).

FxFireLetters.label: Letters
FxFireLetters.hint: Which letters it is on: all of them, only the letters selected in the viewer when you chose this (Use Selected Letters picks again), or all but those.

FxFireLettersUse.label: Use Selected Letters
FxFireLettersUse.hint: Takes the letters selected in the viewer now.

FxFireInside.label: Inside the Letters
FxFireInside.hint: Keeps the fire within the letters' shapes.

FxFireFlames.label: Flames
FxFireFlames.hint: How strong the flames are (0: embers only).

FxFireEmbers.label: Embers
FxFireEmbers.hint: How many sparks fly off the letters.

FxFireDirection.label: Fire Direction
FxFireDirection.hint: The way the flames and embers go, in degrees: 90 up, 0 right, -90 down.

FxFireCenter.label: Center Effect
FxFireCenter.hint: The fire starts only from an area in the middle of the text (Center X, Center Y and Center Width move and size it); the flames still go along Fire Direction.

FxFireCenterX.label: Center X
FxFireCenterX.hint: Moves the area along the text, in % of its width: 0 the middle, -50 its left end, 50 its right end.

FxFireCenterY.label: Center Y
FxFireCenterY.hint: Moves the area up or down, in % of the text's height (0: its middle).

FxFireCenterWidth.label: Center Width
FxFireCenterWidth.hint: How wide the area is, in % of the text's width (0: a point).

FxFireColor.label: Fire Color (Red)
FxFireColor.hint: The flames' main colour; their cores are hotter, their tips deeper.

FxFireColorGreen.label: Fire Color (Green)
FxFireColorGreen.hint: The flames' main colour; their cores are hotter, their tips deeper.

FxFireColorBlue.label: Fire Color (Blue)
FxFireColorBlue.hint: The flames' main colour; their cores are hotter, their tips deeper.

FxFrostLetters.label: Letters

FxFrostLettersUse.label: Use Selected Letters

FxFrostInside.label: Inside the Letters

FxFrostMist.label: Mist

FxFrostHeight.label: Mist Reach
FxFrostHeight.hint: How far the mist and snow go.

FxFrostSnow.label: Snow
FxFrostSnow.hint: How many flakes drift off the letters.

FxFrostDirection.label: Frost Direction
FxFrostDirection.hint: The way the mist and snow go, in degrees: -90 down, 90 up.

FxFrostCenter.label: Center Effect
FxFrostCenter.hint: The mist and snow start only from an area in the middle of the text (Center X, Center Y and Center Width move and size it); they still go along Frost Direction.

FxFrostCenterX.label: Center X
FxFrostCenterX.hint: Moves the area along the text, in % of its width: 0 the middle, -50 its left end, 50 its right end.

FxFrostCenterY.label: Center Y
FxFrostCenterY.hint: Moves the area up or down, in % of the text's height (0: its middle).

FxFrostCenterWidth.label: Center Width
FxFrostCenterWidth.hint: How wide the area is, in % of the text's width (0: a point).

FxSmokeLettersUse.label: Use Selected Letters
FxSmokeLettersUse.hint: Takes the letters selected in the viewer now.

FxSmokeInside.label: Inside the Letters
FxSmokeInside.hint: Keeps the smoke within the letters' shapes.

FxSmokeDirection.label: Smoke Direction
FxSmokeDirection.hint: The way the smoke drifts, in degrees: 90 up, 0 right.

FxSmokeCenter.label: Center Effect
FxSmokeCenter.hint: The smoke starts only from an area in the middle of the text (Center X, Center Y and Center Width move and size it); it still drifts along Smoke Direction.

FxSmokeCenterX.label: Center X
FxSmokeCenterX.hint: Moves the area along the text, in % of its width: 0 the middle, -50 its left end, 50 its right end.

FxSmokeCenterY.label: Center Y
FxSmokeCenterY.hint: Moves the area up or down, in % of the text's height (0: its middle).

FxSmokeCenterWidth.label: Center Width
FxSmokeCenterWidth.hint: How wide the area is, in % of the text's width (0: a point).

FxElectricOn.hint: Crackling electric arcs round the letters.

FxElectricLetters.hint: Which letters it is on: all of them, only the letters selected in the viewer when you chose this (Use Selected Letters picks again), or all but those.

FxElectricLettersUse.label: Use Selected Letters
FxElectricLettersUse.hint: Takes the letters selected in the viewer now.

FxElectricInside.label: Inside the Letters
FxElectricInside.hint: Keeps the arcs within the letters' shapes.

FxElectricReach.label: Arc Reach
FxElectricReach.hint: How far the arcs jump from the letters.

FxRaysOn.label: Light Rays
FxRaysOn.hint: Rays of light streaming out from behind the letters.

FxRaysLetters.label: Letters
FxRaysLetters.hint: Which letters it is on: all of them, only the letters selected in the viewer when you chose this (Use Selected Letters picks again), or all but those.

FxRaysLettersUse.label: Use Selected Letters
FxRaysLettersUse.hint: Takes the letters selected in the viewer now.

FxRaysDirection.label: Ray Direction
FxRaysDirection.hint: The way the rays shine, in degrees: 90 up, 0 right, -90 down.

FxRaysCenter.label: Center Effect
FxRaysCenter.hint: The rays burst out all round from the middle of the text (Center X and Center Y move that point, Center Width stretches it along the text); Ray Direction is not used.

FxRaysCenterX.label: Center X
FxRaysCenterX.hint: Moves the point along the text, in % of its width: 0 the middle, -50 its left end, 50 its right end.

FxRaysCenterY.label: Center Y
FxRaysCenterY.hint: Moves the point up or down, in % of the text's height (0: its middle).

FxRaysCenterWidth.label: Center Width
FxRaysCenterWidth.hint: How wide the light's source is, in % of the text's width (0: a point).

FxShineLettersUse.label: Use Selected Letters
FxShineLettersUse.hint: Takes the letters selected in the viewer now.

FxShineEvery.hint: The time from one sweep to the next.

FxShineDirection.label: Shine Direction
FxShineDirection.hint: The way the band travels, in degrees: 0 left to right, 90 up.

FxShineCenter.label: Center Effect
FxShineCenter.hint: The shine sweeps only across an area in the middle of the text (Center X, Center Y and Center Width move and size it), along Shine Direction.

FxShineCenterX.label: Center X
FxShineCenterX.hint: Moves the area along the text, in % of its width: 0 the middle, -50 its left end, 50 its right end.

FxShineCenterY.label: Center Y
FxShineCenterY.hint: Moves the area up or down, in % of the text's height (0: its middle).

FxShineCenterWidth.label: Center Width
FxShineCenterWidth.hint: How wide the area is, in % of the text's width (0: a point).

FitToFrame.label: Fit to Frame
FitToFrame.hint: Shrinks the text (never grows it) when it would run out of the frame, keeping a small margin, also when it is turned or resized. Moving it with Position, and letters flying in or out with the In and Out rows, can still pass the edges.

MyLookName.label: Look Name

MyLookSave.label: Save as My Look

MyLookFolder.label: Open My Looks Folder
MyLookFolder.hint: Shows the folder your looks are saved in (Load Look... opens it too).
